facts: Parties: Juniper Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Holloway Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Corrib Capital LLP.
This Agreement is dated 4 April 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 July 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $5,000,000, capped at $3,000,000.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 4 April 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $700,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $6,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,200,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 16 October 2026.
